title: Bazel Source Universe
description: Which directories the world witness of a planner run must observe so that a recorded plan is reused only while git would list the same sources. A pattern whose literal prefix is empty (`**/🧬️schema/**/*.json`) reaches the whole checkout; the walk below the root then skips every directory name that each such pattern's own task excludes completely with a negation of the shape `**/<name>/**`, `**/{a,b}/**` or `**/.*/**`. A root-anchored pattern without such a negation leaves the universe unbounded and the plan is not reused.

Policy.description: Closed constants: the negation shapes that prune a directory name, and the probe paths that the runtime glob must exclude before a name counts as pruned (one below the root, one deeper).

Groups.description: The expanded string inputs of every cacheable task of one plan, one array per task; a leading `!` marks a negation of that task.

Universe.description: `roots`: the minimal directories below which every non-root-anchored pattern lies, walked completely. `whole`: null when no pattern is root-anchored; `unbounded` when one has no pruning negation; otherwise the directory names (and dot names) every root-anchored pattern excludes.
